Next year marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, and the iPhone Pro models are reportedly set to adopt a brand-new design. The latest leak has revealed what are claimed to be larger upcoming screen sizes.

iPhone Pro to feature larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch displays next year

Back in 2017 for the iPhone's 10th anniversary, Apple had a very special model ready: the iPhone X.

There are reports the company is preparing a similarly unique product for next year's 20th anniversary.

Next year's iPhone Pro models are said to feature a bezel-less, four-corner curved display that extends to the edges of the device.

The Dynamic Island cutout may shrink or be removed entirely, achieving an all-glass, seamless appearance.

According to a recent post by leaker Digital Chat Station, Apple is also preparing new screen sizes. They said the company is testing the following specifications:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4 inches, up from the current 6.3 inches
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7 inches, up from the current 6.9 inches

They added that the actual body dimensions of both devices will also increase, but the aspect ratio of the current models will be maintained. So the larger screens aren't just down to narrower bezels.

The last time Apple increased the size of the Pro models was in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro went from 6.1 inches to 6.3 inches, and the Pro Max from 6.7 inches to 6.9 inches.

Although the size increase next year appears modest, the four-corner curved design should make for a distinctly different in-hand feel.

What are your thoughts on the rumoured design of next year's iPhone Pro models? Let us know in the comments.
